# `from_utc_timestamp`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
from_utc_timestamp(timestamp, timezone)
```

Given a timestamp like '2017-07-14 02:40:00.0', interprets it as a time in UTC, and renders that time as a timestamp in the given time zone. For example, 'GMT+1' would yield '2017-07-14 03:40:00.0'.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- from_utc_timestamp, example 1
> SELECT from_utc_timestamp('2016-08-31', 'Asia/Seoul');
2016-08-31 09:00:00
```
